title: Bounded investigation of an identity session

questions.prompt: Did the session originate through egress managed by the bound organization?
questions.proposition: The bound session used egress managed by the bound organization during the bound interval.
questions.applicabilityCriteria: Applies to the bound subject, organization, and window when all required parameters are resolved.

assessmentCriteria.yes: Correlated VPN and inventory evidence establishes egress managed by the bound organization.
assessmentCriteria.no: Sufficient authoritative inventory and session coverage establishes that the egress was not managed by the bound organization.
assessmentCriteria.unknown: Inventory, session correlation, or coverage is missing or conflicting.

evidenceRequirements: Evidence correlating the bound subject and interval with the proposition; negative answers require stated observation coverage.

questions.proposition: A party replayed this session token in the bound organization's identity context during the bound interval.
questions.applicabilityCriteria: Applies to the bound subject, organization, and window when all required parameters are resolved.

assessmentCriteria.yes: Correlated issuer, device, or token evidence establishes replay for this session.
assessmentCriteria.no: Sufficient stated issuer, device, and token observation coverage establishes no replay in this interval.
assessmentCriteria.unknown: Available evidence cannot establish replay or its absence with sufficient coverage.

evidenceRequirements: Evidence correlating the bound subject and interval with the proposition; negative answers require stated observation coverage.
